d: Americans head to the polls in a midterm election that could reshape the balance of power in Washington. Republicans currently control both chambers of Congress, but Democrats are hoping to capitalise on growing dissatisfaction with President Donald Trump and flip the House — with the Senate also in play. Though Trump is not on the ballot, he has made the election a referendum on his presidency.
